nodes.name: Google Sheets Trigger
nodes.notes: Polls every 60 seconds for new form submissions. No webhook needed — reliable for Google Forms.

nodes.name: HTTP Request — Fetch CV from Drive
nodes.notes: Fetches the actual binary file from Google Drive. The URL column name must match your form field label exactly.

nodes.name: Code — Extract & Prepare CV Data
nodes.notes: Converts binary CV to base64. Organises all form fields into clean JSON for downstream nodes.

nodes.name: HTTP Request — Gemini AI Screening
nodes.notes: CRITICAL: The prompt must force strict JSON output. If Gemini returns prose, the downstream Code node will throw a JSON.parse error.

nodes.name: Code — Parse Gemini Response
nodes.notes: Extracts score from Gemini's nested candidates array. Includes validation and error handling. Merges AI results with applicant data.

nodes.name: HTTP Request — Create Notion Page
nodes.notes: Creates a new candidate card in your Notion Talent Board. All 9 properties must match your database schema exactly — type mismatches cause 400 errors.

nodes.name: IF — Score >= 7?
nodes.notes: TRUE branch: high-scoring candidate → WhatsApp alert. FALSE branch: workflow ends — candidate is still logged in Notion.

nodes.name: HTTP Request — WhatsApp Alert
nodes.notes: Only fires for candidates scoring 7 or above. Sends full candidate summary with Notion link to hiring manager. WhatsApp tokens expire after 24hrs — use a system user token for production.

main.node: HTTP Request — Fetch CV from Drive
